notes: An FM broadcast station carrying RDS. Not the house sample rate:
2.048 MS/s, because the multiplex runs to 57 kHz on a carrier that
deviates 75 kHz and the discriminator wants room for both.
Measured on the 4 s recording this is the first 2 s of: the 19 kHz
pilot stands 48.8 dB over the floor at exactly 19000.00 Hz, the RDS
band 13 dB over it, and the RDS carrier itself only 5.6 dB, which is
what a suppressed carrier looks like.
The station is not identified yet -- naming it needs the programme
identification code, which needs the decoder in ticket 02. The file
is named for the frequency until then, and the station is local and
permanent, so it can always be recorded again.
